channel.title: Andalusia Star News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Andalusia Star News (andalusiastarnews.com)

item.title: Maxine Kennedy Marshall Obituary
item.description: Obituary: Maxine Kennedy Marshall, 78, of Opp, Alabama, passed away March 8, 2026; funeral services were held March 11 with burial at Ino Baptist Church Cemetery.

item.title: Jail Report from March 17 through March 19
item.description: Covington County Jail bookings from March 17–19 list arrests on charges including probation violations, domestic violence, drug offenses, child support, theft and rape.

item.title: Local man charged with rape
item.description: Andalusia man Marlin Keith Bozeman, 49, is charged with first-degree rape and held on $150,000 bond after an investigation involving victim interviews and security footage.

item.title: East Three Notch Waterline repaired
item.description: Andalusia crews repair deeply buried waterline struck during fiber work at East Three Notch and Bypass, limiting outages and planning lane reopening after backfill.

item.title: Cattlemen hold historic meeting
item.description: Covington County Cattlemen drew one of their largest March crowds at their first 2026 meeting, recognizing members and hearing from candidates and ACA leaders as Wyatt Sasser becomes president.

item.title: OCS’ Edgar announces retirement
item.description: Opp City Schools Superintendent Emily Edgar will retire June 1, closing a 37-year career with the system she joined at 19 and calling the superintendent role her career pinnacle.

item.title: CHRIST TOOK THE PUNISHMENT FOR OUR SINS
item.description: Chuck Colson’s Prison Fellowship shares how a Brazilian prison was transformed, pointing to Christ who took the punishment for our sins so anyone can be forgiven.

item.title: City of Andy approves budget, ABC license
item.description: Andalusia council adds $481,770 for high school upgrades, approves Off the Trax special-events ABC license, and begins process to surplus a former Salvation Army site.

item.title: Revive Worship and FBC Gantt hold Youth Revival
item.description: FBC Gantt hosted its first Youth Revival as Revive Worship and speaker Caleb Bell brought together over 100 students from area youth groups for a Christ-centered night.

item.title: NEW FACES IN LBW’S PTK
item.description: LBW’s Phi Theta Kappa chapter inducted 43 students on March 16, honoring academic excellence, rising membership and research projects serving campus and community.
